slides.title: Is refugee registration paused in Ethiopia?
What UNHCR's chief said
slides.body: Barham Salih said registration was suspended for tens of thousands of refugees from South Sudan and Eritrea in Ethiopia.

slides.title: The funding picture
slides.body: He told UNHCR's executive committee the agency has secured $3 billion, about 35% of the $8.5 billion it needs for 2026.

slides.title: What is not stated
slides.body: No figure per country or start date was given in the Reuters report.

slides.title: Protect refugees. Keep registration and aid open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
